notes: Address Book: Location and Gender are now required for buyers and sellers (the Cash Sales buyer is exempt); sellers get a 'Name (Tamil)' field (for future Tamil invoices). Print Due List: the gender toggle is now All / Gents / Ladies (blue/green/gold, Unassigned removed); the list only builds when you click the new 'Show list' button (it never auto-loads while you scroll the date); the rupee sign sits closer to the amount while staying in a straight column; the cleared-day line no longer collides with நேர்; buyers print Active first then Dormant, and dormant buyers get an amber block border.
